description: Every file of the report but one lies in another checkout. Point 1 claims that another checkout wrote the report, and a single file left here denies it — no run writes such a report, and the files moved are simply not where point 3 looks for them. Any rule short of "every file" — "any", "most", "all but one" — would take this case and blame a checkout for a report it did not write; the file left here is what tells them apart, and it is code rather than a template, so a rule that counted code alone would read it the same.
